claims.claim: Scrap compact audio system, currently not functioning, sold as-is for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: Photo shows a dusty unit on the floor with no power-on, no display lit, no audio test shown; functional state cannot be confirmed from a static photo.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, no dead key, no crackle
claims.evidence: This directly conflicts with the seller's own description that the unit is 'currently not functioning' and sold 'for parts or recycling' — the two statements cannot both be true.
No adapter/power cable is clearly shown as a matching OEM unit in the photo; only a loose cable bundle is visible, which cannot be confirmed as the correct adapter.
No import paperwork, UK plug/voltage sticker, or box shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on at all
risks.proof: Video clip of unit plugged in, powering on, display lighting up
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/for parts, per seller's own description

risks.risk: CD changer and cassette decks may be mechanically seized or damaged
risks.proof: Video of CD tray cycling through 3 discs and both cassette doors opening/playing

risks.risk: No speakers included, buyer may need to source separately
risks.proof: Photo showing matching speaker pair or explicit confirmation none are included
risks.if_unproven: priced as main unit only, no speakers

risks.proof: Photo of remote included in sale

risks.risk: Adapter may be wrong voltage/plug or missing entirely
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the actual adapter with voltage rating and plug type
risks.if_unproven: priced as no working adapter included

proof_requests: Video of the unit plugged in and powering on
Video/audio clip of sound output through speakers to check for crackle or dead channels
Close-up photo of the adapter/power cable with voltage and plug type
Photo confirming presence or absence of remote control and speakers
Clarify the contradiction: is the unit functioning or not?
response.reason: The seller's own words directly contradict each other, calling the unit both 'currently not functioning, for parts' and 'all keys and buttons working, no dead key, no crackle', which is a classic sign of a copy-pasted or dishonest listing.
